tagline: Pan-India Heavy Rainfall & Inundation Early Warning System
hackathon_theme: Smart India Hackathon 2026 - AI/ML-Based Integrated Heavy Rainfall Early Warning & Inundation Prediction System

theme_strategy.visual_archetype: Emergency Management Command Center / Precision Civic SaaS
theme_strategy.tone: Authoritative, crisp, life-critical, calm, objective, transparent
theme_strategy.base_theme: Light mode primary (clean crisp white/light background with pale blue-slate structural panels) with high-contrast tactical dark navy typography and disciplined alert accents

typography.font_family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
scale.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scale.metric_giant: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight

header.type: Sticky solid white header with 1px border-b border-slate-200 shadow-xs
header.left: Logo: RAIN VISION with radar wave glyph + Tagline subtext
header.center: Tabs / Navigation pills: Dashboard, Live Risk Map, Rainfall Forecast, Inundation Risk, Alerts, Data Sources, Offline Mode, Analytics, Settings
header.right: Live Network Badge (Online/Offline) + Emergency Demo Mode CTA + GPS trigger button

grid_modes.dashboard: Bento High Density: Top summary bar with 5 urgent metrics -> Main 2-column split (Left: Map preview & Risk breakdown, Right: Hourly precipitation & Inundation timeline) -> Bottom: Nearby points & Active Geofence notice
grid_modes.map_view: Full-height interactive GIS container with floating control overlays (Radius slider, City quick-jumps, Pan-India layers, clicked coordinates HUD)
grid_modes.forecast: Chronological meteorological stream with Recharts dual-axis (Precipitation mm/h vs Probability %)

EmergencyStatusBanner.description: Crucial top banner answering immediately: IS THERE DANGER? WHERE? WHEN? HOW SEVERE? WHAT SHOULD PEOPLE DO?
states: Normal state: Muted slate/emerald reassuring card
Geofenced Alert state: Vivid high-contrast amber/rose border-2 card with concrete safety recommendations
Offline state: Amber warning card indicating cached operational mode & local alert engine active

LeafletMapComponent.description: True interactive OpenStreetMap Leaflet integration with coordinates HUD, dynamic user circle marker, configurable radius ring (5/10/25/50 km), and surrounding grid points
pins: Selected/Clicked pin (Amber pin with popover data)
Pan-India major city risk markers (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Guwahati, Kochi, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Patna, Srinagar, Bhubaneswar, Jaipur)

RiskFusionEngineCard.description: Clear transparent breakdown of AI / Data Fusion weights: Rain (30%), Probability (20%), Accumulation (20%), NWP Model (15%), Cloud/Radar (5%), Vulnerability Proxy (10%)
RiskFusionEngineCard.disclaimer: Prototype risk thresholds and weights require calibration against historical observations before operational deployment.

InundationRiskCard.description: Prototype inundation metric card detailing surface water risk, hourly runoff trend, contributing factors
InundationRiskCard.disclaimer: This prototype does not provide validated street-level flood-depth prediction.

EmergencyDemoPanel.description: Interactive jury controller stepping through: Normal -> Rainfall Increase -> Moderate -> High -> Extreme -> Alert Triggered -> Geofenced Warning -> Network Failure -> Offline Mode -> Cached Data + Local Alert Engine -> Network Recovery

OfflineStatusBar.description: Detects real navigator.onLine and demo trigger, switches seamlessly to cached JSON, shows exact DATA AGE in minutes and Last Live Update timestamp

SmsFutureIntegrationModal.description: Transparent SMS Payload Ready dialog showing masked recipient (+91 98*** **420), payload text, and explicit 'SMS GATEWAY: NOT CONFIGURED (FUTURE INTEGRATION)' disclaimer

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive buttons, input fields, tabs, metric chips, and status badges MUST include semantic kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g., data-testid='nav-tab-dashboard', data-testid='btn-emergency-demo', data-testid='status-network-badge', data-testid='input-search-location', data-testid='btn-refresh-location')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a comprehensive single-page dashboard with robust sub-view switching (Dashboard, Live Risk Map, Rainfall Forecast, Inundation Risk, Alerts, Data Sources, Offline Mode, Analytics, Settings).
Ensure Open-Meteo real coordinates API calls run reliably for the active location (latitude, longitude) and recalculate deterministic risk based on the specified fusion formula.
Bengaluru (12.9716° N, 77.5946° E) is the primary default location with seamless browser Geolocation override.
Strictly honor the NO RANDOM LIVE RISK rule; keep live mode deterministic from API values, reserving step-by-step simulations strictly for the Emergency Demo Scenario.
Implement real window 'online'/'offline' event listeners and automatic localStorage synchronization for full offline resilience.
Ensure Leaflet maps render with standard OpenStreetMap tiles, accurate markers, custom pulsing user dot, and monitoring radius circle.
Always maintain explicit provenance badges (LIVE, FALLBACK, DEMO, SIMULATED, FUTURE, UNAVAILABLE) without falsifying IMD, ISRO, or SMS delivery.
